display.name: Hub · Crowd favourites
display.description: The bot's greatest hits: handlers, command aliases, buttons and conversation steps. Handler totals use unsampled metrics; aliases and latency use sampled traces.

display.name: Popular handlers
display.description: Completed handler calls from unsampled metrics. Includes buttons and conversation steps; aliases share a handler. Totals separate process/counter epochs and include initial values only for epochs starting within the selected window.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (
    SELECT
        service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 'cumulative' THEN start_timestamp END AS counter_epoch,
        aggregation_temporality,
        attributes->>'boundary' AS boundary,
        attributes->>'operation' AS operation,
        attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
        attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
        attributes->>'backend' AS backend,
        attributes->>'update.kind' AS update_kind,
        metric_increase(value, recorded_timestamp)
            + CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 'cumulative'
                AND MIN(start_timestamp) >= CAST($__from_iso_string AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                AND MIN(start_timestamp) <= CAST($__to_iso_string AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                THEN COALESCE(MIN(scalar_value), 0) ELSE 0 END AS n
    FROM metrics
    WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
      AND metric_name = 'bot.operations' AND attributes->>'boundary' = 'bot.handler' AND attributes->>'outcome' <> 'ignored'
    GROUP BY service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, counter_epoch, aggregation_temporality, boundary, operation, outcome, provider, backend, update_kind
)
SELECT operation AS handler, SUM(n) AS invocations
FROM streams GROUP BY handler HAVING SUM(n) > 0
ORDER BY invocations DESC, handler LIMIT 15

display.name: Handler reliability
display.description: Failure % covers success, unavailable, timeout and unexpected outcomes. Rejected, ignored and cancelled calls are shown separately. Totals separate process/counter epochs and include initial values only for epochs starting within the selected window.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (
    SELECT
        service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 'cumulative' THEN start_timestamp END AS counter_epoch,
        aggregation_temporality,
        attributes->>'boundary' AS boundary,
        attributes->>'operation' AS operation,
        attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
        attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
        attributes->>'backend' AS backend,
        attributes->>'update.kind' AS update_kind,
        metric_increase(value, recorded_timestamp)
            + CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 'cumulative'
                AND MIN(start_timestamp) >= CAST($__from_iso_string AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                AND MIN(start_timestamp) <= CAST($__to_iso_string AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                THEN COALESCE(MIN(scalar_value), 0) ELSE 0 END AS n
    FROM metrics
    WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
      AND metric_name = 'bot.operations' AND attributes->>'boundary' = 'bot.handler'
    GROUP BY service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, counter_epoch, aggregation_temporality, boundary, operation, outcome, provider, backend, update_kind
)
SELECT operation AS handler,
       SUM(n) AS invocations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'success' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded,
       SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS failed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'rejected' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS rejected,
       SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'ignored' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS ignored,
       SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'cancelled' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled,
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') THEN n ELSE 0 END)
         / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('success', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unexpected') THEN n ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failure_percent
FROM streams GROUP BY handler HAVING SUM(n) > 0
ORDER BY failed DESC, invocations DESC, handler LIMIT 30

display.name: Command aliases · sampled
display.description: Registered command aliases in retained traces. Sampling and the trace budget can affect this ranking.

spec.query:
SELECT CASE WHEN attributes->>'command.kind' = 'hashtag' THEN '#' ELSE '/' END
         || (attributes->>'command') AS command,
       COUNT(*) AS sampled_invocations
FROM records
WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'span' AND span_name = 'bot.handler'
  AND attributes->>'command' IS NOT NULL
  AND attributes->>'outcome' <> 'ignored'
GROUP BY command ORDER BY sampled_invocations DESC, command LIMIT 15

display.name: Slash or hashtag · sampled
display.description: How people invoke commands in the retained sample: slash commands or hashtags.

spec.query:
SELECT attributes->>'command.kind' AS entry,
       COUNT(*) AS sampled_invocations
FROM records
WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'span' AND span_name = 'bot.handler'
  AND attributes->>'command' IS NOT NULL
  AND attributes->>'command.kind' IN ('slash', 'hashtag')
  AND attributes->>'outcome' <> 'ignored'
GROUP BY entry ORDER BY sampled_invocations DESC, entry

display.name: Handler activity
display.description: Completed handler calls per minute, grouped by Telegram update kind. Excludes ignored handlers.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (
    SELECT
        time_bucket($resolution, recorded_timestamp) AS x,
        service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 'cumulative' THEN start_timestamp END AS counter_epoch,
        aggregation_temporality,
        attributes->>'boundary' AS boundary,
        attributes->>'operation' AS operation,
        attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
        attributes->>'provider' AS provider,
        attributes->>'backend' AS backend,
        attributes->>'update.kind' AS update_kind,
        metric_rate(value, recorded_timestamp) AS n
    FROM metrics
    WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production'
      AND metric_name = 'bot.operations' AND attributes->>'boundary' = 'bot.handler' AND attributes->>'outcome' <> 'ignored'
    GROUP BY x, service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, counter_epoch, aggregation_temporality, boundary, operation, outcome, provider, backend, update_kind
)
SELECT x, COALESCE(update_kind, 'unknown') AS update_kind, 60 * SUM(n) AS invocations_per_minute
FROM streams GROUP BY x, update_kind ORDER BY x, update_kind

display.name: Handler latency · sampled
display.description: Sampled wall time including awaited dependencies. Compare p95 with the sample count.

spec.query:
SELECT COALESCE(attributes->>'handler', attributes->>'operation', 'unknown') AS handler,
       COUNT(*) AS sampled_invocations,
       round(1000 * AVG(duration), 1) AS mean_ms,
       round(1000 * approx_percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration), 1) AS p95_ms,
       round(1000 * MAX(duration), 1) AS max_ms
FROM records
WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'span' AND span_name = 'bot.handler'
  AND duration IS NOT NULL AND attributes->>'outcome' <> 'ignored'
GROUP BY handler ORDER BY p95_ms DESC, sampled_invocations DESC LIMIT 20

display.name: Recent commands · private sample
display.description: Recent sampled commands with numeric user/chat IDs. Open a trace to see its requests and timing.

spec.query:
SELECT date_trunc('second', start_timestamp) AS time_utc,
       CASE WHEN attributes->>'command.kind' = 'hashtag' THEN '#' ELSE '/' END
         || (attributes->>'command') AS command,
       attributes->>'handler' AS handler, attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,
       round(1000 * duration, 1) AS duration_ms,
       json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.user_id') AS actor_user_id,
       json_get_int(attributes, 'telegram.chat_id') AS source_chat_id,
       trace_id, span_id
FROM records
WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind = 'span' AND span_name = 'bot.handler'
  AND attributes->>'command' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 30
